title: Go / Node.js Backend Developer
introText:
Backend developer with 3+ years of hands-on experience building high-load Node.js services with NestJS. I specialize in designing and optimizing PostgreSQL-backed catalogs, search services on Elasticsearch, and event-driven integration between services via Kafka.
Comfortable with REST API design, Redis caching, data-consistency patterns (Transactional Outbox), and integrating AI-driven modules (OpenAI API, pgvector) into product workflows. I cover code with unit tests (Jest) and support services in production (Docker, GitLab CI, Kubernetes, Prometheus/Grafana).
